About The Company

L3Harris Technologies is a leading provider of advanced defense and aerospace solutions dedicated to supporting national security and operational excellence. With a focus on innovation, integrity, and customer-centricity, L3Harris delivers end-to-end technology solutions that connect space, air, land, sea, and cyber domains. The company fosters a culture of high performance, inclusivity, and continuous professional growth, ensuring its workforce remains at the forefront of technological advancements. Committed to community engagement and operational excellence, L3Harris strives to make a meaningful impact through its pioneering solutions and dedicated team members.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Specialist, Software Engineer/Data Analyst to join our dynamic team in Melbourne, FL. This role is critical in modernizing and migrating analytics applications into high-performance web-based solutions utilizing contemporary web technologies. The ideal candidate will possess an active TS/SCI clearance and have experience working in classified or high-security environments. The position involves close collaboration with system engineers, cloud engineers, cyber teams, and mission stakeholders to deliver comprehensive solutions aligned with organizational and mission objectives. Periodic travel to Patrick Space Force Base may be required to support operational needs and project deployment.

Qualifications

The successful candidate should possess a bachelor’s degree with a minimum of four years of relevant experience; a graduate degree with at least two years of experience; or, in the absence of a degree, at least eight years of pertinent professional experience. An active TS/SCI clearance is mandatory. Candidates with additional certifications such as Security+ or DoD IAT Level II are preferred, with the ability to obtain necessary certifications within six months of employment. A strong background in software development, data analysis, and experience working in classified environments will be advantageous.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications, including user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and data integrations to support mission-critical operations.
Create modern, responsive, and intuitive front-end interfaces using current web development frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue, adhering to best practices for usability and performance.
Develop secure, scalable backend services and application logic utilizing languages like Python, Java, Node.js, or .NET, ensuring robustness and security compliance.
Deploy, monitor, and maintain applications within AWS cloud environments, ensuring solutions are scalable, resilient, and cost-effective while integrating cloud-native services and databases such as DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Implement software engineering best practices including code reviews, automated testing, version control, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams—including system engineers, cyber specialists, and mission stakeholders—to gather requirements, define technical specifications, and deliver comprehensive solutions.
Engage directly with customers to understand operational needs, gather feedback, and iterate on application functionality to enhance mission effectiveness.
Prepare architectural designs, technical implementation plans, and roadmaps aligned with organizational and mission goals, ensuring clarity and strategic alignment.
Maintain detailed technical documentation covering system design, deployment procedures, and sustainment activities to facilitate ongoing support and knowledge transfer.
Deliver professional presentations and technical briefings to stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights.
Support various mission areas by adapting to evolving operational priorities within a dynamic environment, ensuring mission success and operational readiness.
Maintain familiarity with classified environments such as the C2S Access Portal (CAP) and high-side AWS environments, ensuring compliance with security protocols.
Utilize knowledge of relational and non-relational databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or DynamoDB, to support data-driven applications.

Benefits

L3Harris offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional development of its employees. Benefits include competitive health insurance options, retirement plans, paid time off, and opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement. The company promotes a flexible work environment, recognizing the importance of work-life balance. Additionally, employees have access to various wellness programs, employee resource groups, and community engagement initiatives. L3Harris values its workforce and invests in their success through mentorship, training, and leadership development programs.

Equal Opportunity

L3Harris Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and dignity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We maintain a drug-free workplace and conduct pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks where permitted by law. We encourage qualified individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team, supporting our mission to deliver innovative solutions for national security and defense.

THE PURCHASING TEAM

The purchasing team manages all equipment and materials purchases for both job sites and corporate expenditures. This includes vetting vendors and establishing and maintaining relationships with new and loyal suppliers

About The Role

The Procurement Data Analyst is responsible for maintaining the accuracy, integrity, and effectiveness of procurement and asset-related data to support operational efficiency and informed business decisions. This role serves as a key steward of procurement master data, including item master records, equipment and fleet data, vendor pricing, and procurement system information. The position analyzes data trends, develops reports and dashboards, supports vendor pricing and point-of-sale data management, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to improve processes, enhance system capabilities, and support automation initiatives. Working with general direction, the Procurement Data Analyst independently manages assigned data domains, investigates issues, recommends solutions, and collaborates with stakeholders to implement improvements.

Serve as a steward of procurement master data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency across key datasets, including the Item Master, equipment and fleet data, vendor pricing, and procurement systems.
Maintain the Item Master throughout its lifecycle, including new item creation, standardization, updates, and data cleanup to support consistent use across the organization.
Analyze procurement and asset-related data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, supporting process optimization and informed decision-making.
Coordinate vendor pricing updates, including weekly pricing maintenance and the collection of monthly or quarterly point-of-sale (POS) data, ensuring timely and accurate data availability.
Partner with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, streamline processes, enhance system functionality, and support automation initiatives. Conduct analyses of equipment categories and project mobilizations to support buy-versus-rent decisions.
Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that track procurement metrics, supplier performance, and system effectiveness, ensuring insights are accurate, actionable, and aligned with business objectives.
Partner with procurement leadership and IT teams in evaluating and implementing system enhancements and automation opportunities that improve efficiency and data integrity.
Independently manage assigned responsibilities, exercising sound judgment to identify issues, evaluate alternatives, recommend solutions, and drive issues through resolution.
Participate in testing, validation, and implementation of system enhancements and updates, working with cross-functional teams to ensure successful deployment and minimal operational disruption.
Create and maintain documentation for data structures, business processes, reporting, and system procedures to promote standardization and knowledge sharing.

About You

Knowledge of master data management principles, and supply chain data concepts, including item master, vendor, pricing, and asset/equipment data.
Knowledge of data governance practices, data quality standards, and methods for maintaining accurate and consistent business data.
Skill in analyzing and interpreting procurement, asset, and operational data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Skill in developing reports, dashboards, and performance metrics using reporting and data visualization tools.
Skill in using enterprise systems and databases (e.g., ERP, procurement, inventory, or asset management systems) to maintain and analyze data.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate recurring data maintenance activities, and meet established deadlines with a high degree of accuracy.
Ability to collaborate effectively with procurement, operations, finance, IT, suppliers, and other stakeholders to resolve data and process issues.
Ability to identify root causes of data discrepancies, evaluate solutions, and make sound recommendations based on analysis.
Ability to document business processes, data standards, and system procedures to support consistency, compliance, and knowledge sharing.
Ability to support system enhancements, testing activities, and process improvement initiatives through effective communication, organization, and attention to detail.

Minimum Qualifications

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.

Licensure/Certifications: N/A

Experience:

Three (3) or more years of experience in data analytics, business systems, master data management, business analysis, process improvement, or a related function.

Experience with Microsoft Power Platform strongly preferred, including Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, Power Apps, and Dataverse, with hands-on experience developing, maintaining, or troubleshooting reporting, workflows, applications, or automation solutions.

Experience working with enterprise systems and business data, including ERP, asset management, procurement, inventory, or similar platforms, is preferred.

Experience with JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, procurement, construction, or other asset-heavy environments is a plus.

About The Role

The Procurement Data Analyst is responsible for maintaining the accuracy, integrity, and effectiveness of procurement and asset-related data to support operational efficiency and informed business decisions. This role serves as a key steward of procurement master data, including item master records, equipment and fleet data, vendor pricing, and procurement system information. The position analyzes data trends, develops reports and dashboards, supports vendor pricing and point-of-sale data management, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to improve processes, enhance system capabilities, and support automation initiatives. Working with general direction, the Procurement Data Analyst independently manages assigned data domains, investigates issues, recommends solutions, and collaborates with stakeholders to implement improvements.

Serve as a steward of procurement master data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency across key datasets, including the Item Master, equipment and fleet data, vendor pricing, and procurement systems.
Maintain the Item Master throughout its lifecycle, including new item creation, standardization, updates, and data cleanup to support consistent use across the organization.
Analyze procurement and asset-related data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, supporting process optimization and informed decision-making.
Coordinate vendor pricing updates, including weekly pricing maintenance and the collection of monthly or quarterly point-of-sale (POS) data, ensuring timely and accurate data availability.
Partner with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, streamline processes, enhance system functionality, and support automation initiatives. Conduct analyses of equipment categories and project mobilizations to support buy-versus-rent decisions.
Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that track procurement metrics, supplier performance, and system effectiveness, ensuring insights are accurate, actionable, and aligned with business objectives.
Partner with procurement leadership and IT teams in evaluating and implementing system enhancements and automation opportunities that improve efficiency and data integrity.
Independently manage assigned responsibilities, exercising sound judgment to identify issues, evaluate alternatives, recommend solutions, and drive issues through resolution.
Participate in testing, validation, and implementation of system enhancements and updates, working with cross-functional teams to ensure successful deployment and minimal operational disruption.
Create and maintain documentation for data structures, business processes, reporting, and system procedures to promote standardization and knowledge sharing.

Knowledge of master data management principles, and supply chain data concepts, including item master, vendor, pricing, and asset/equipment data.
Knowledge of data governance practices, data quality standards, and methods for maintaining accurate and consistent business data.
Skill in analyzing and interpreting procurement, asset, and operational data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Skill in developing reports, dashboards, and performance metrics using reporting and data visualization tools.
Skill in using enterprise systems and databases (e.g., ERP, procurement, inventory, or asset management systems) to maintain and analyze data.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate recurring data maintenance activities, and meet established deadlines with a high degree of accuracy.
Ability to collaborate effectively with procurement, operations, finance, IT, suppliers, and other stakeholders to resolve data and process issues.
Ability to identify root causes of data discrepancies, evaluate solutions, and make sound recommendations based on analysis.
